scientific_integrity: Self-contained infinite counting argument checked with exact independent finite arithmetic; cited initiating paper supplies smoothness and space-filling. No claim of independent audit or formal certification.
scientific_limitations: Only F2-rational projective lines on the explicitly transformed-base inductive quartic family, n>=3. Geometric line schemes, nonreduced structures, extension-field counts, and other quartic constructions are not calculated. Historical priority is qualified by partial accessible literature and history.
title: Exact rational-line counts for an inductive family of smooth binary space-filling quartics
